block.name: Account settings
block.purpose: Account settings for a billing product: business details, the payout account and notification recipients.
block.description: The settings template filled with three sections: Business details (legal name, statement descriptor, support email, address), Payout account (holder, read-only bank account, schedule, minimum payout) and Notifications (alert, reminder and receipt recipients).
whenToUse: Starting point for the settings area of a billing or payments product.
whenNotToUse: As a component: copy it and wire each section's Save to your API.
rules: Amounts use align end with a currency adornment.
Read-only values say how to change them in a hint.
Save notifications, the last section's button, is the page's only primary Button.
